run_collect_durations: run the script to collect video duration information for all datasets in a folder
run_collect_durations_with_filter: run the script with --only flag to collect durations for specific datasets like ritw and tum
run_collect_durations_with_ignore: run the script with --ignore flag to skip certain datasets like Panda-70M and backlog
review_main_function: review the main function that iterates over datasets and sequences to find videos.mp4 files
refactor_main_search_logic: refactor the main function to support configurable max search depth for finding nested video files
